# ADR-003 KB format
**Decision:** atomic Markdown notes with YAML frontmatter (id, type, title, tags, confidence, sources, summary, updated); `kb/INDEX.md` routes questions to ids; `kb/manifest.json` generated by `node kb/tools/build-index.mjs`.
**Retrieval for agents:** read INDEX.md → open the 1–3 notes needed → cite ids. Search with `grep -ril <term> kb/`.
**Confidence levels:** `source` (from the reference docs), `derived` (reasoned from source + topic), `assumed` (hypothesis), `evidence` (real team research). Only real sessions may produce `evidence`.
**Not doing:** vector DB/embeddings (add only if kb exceeds ~150 notes and grep misses).
